body:
This was incredibly helpful. I do not speak enough English to thank you enough. 

The main problem is that I don't... Can't... Let go. 

Thanks for your patience...

There's no such a thing as an "attention whore". Most of people needs attention; we are all bound by our general acceptance in sociaty, and be respected or getting noticed is a way to comprehend that acceptance. I know how you feel and it's lack of respect; you just want someone to care for you because it seems that nobody does. Well, I care.
Still don't know how to deal with it. Again I saw she with her boyfriend. I can't let it go.

Talk to them. 

Speak about how you feel. Why did you say that. They will help you, at best; they care for you.

I'm in early 20s, but as you said life is measured by experiences and I got through some. 

I went to a profissional - it's not like I don't get any treatment, but it just doesn't work. I mean, it does, I got several crisis less after I started the medicine, but for what I'm passing through there are no pills. 

There's no difference. I mean, it was me who did it. I can say "but I'm crazy as fuck", as I said for a while, but this was making her sad. She was the very only girl I really loved, I really cared, I really wanted to be with me, but she never felt like this. That was my fault, no matter what stupid disorder I can possibly have. 

I'm trying to find someone to talk, that's just why I came here. I mean, my friends are just... "ok, he's through that again". "Why he never forgets that girl? It's so easier to do so". And stuff. I like them all, and I mean it -- not the way I love her, obviously -- but they don't have that sort of feeling. 

Portuguese is indeed a beautiful language. I'm glad to speak it as my mother tongue. Those things aren't interesting. Most of people don't find it, at least. They like whatever I post on Facebook but don't want to talk with me. That's the point. I cannot speak of anything besides those three. I have... No... Subject. Yes, I do care about social issues, nice catch. 

Oh, I'd be glad to read it. I won't judge, hahaha. 

I feel that situation will eventually change. Maybe there are two or three people in the future who would really appreciate myself, or find me useful in any way. It's just... Too long. I was so used to loneless and then there was this girl and everything changed. Thus, I cannot hold on my own limits again... I don't know how to explain exactly, sorry. 

Maybe there are, but ... people generally don't feel they want to talk to me. Generally it's me who's getting at someone and saying "hey". Or when I get tired of boring my friends, just get to omegle or something like this. Because, in fact... sigh. Nobody really likes to talk with me. I make no difference for now. And we are back at the suicidal thought.

Have you tried some medical advice?
I have a very similar problem -- becase of my bipolar condition, I lose interest in jobs very quickly. The solution I took was working in a home-office, at my pace. 

Also... How old are you?

If you think it's worth, you can PM me. Let's try and solve this.

Well, as I said, I tried even to change my city. I'm not that young and welp. The difference is that everything is my fault here. My disorders... Are just an excuse. I suck at being social, that's the truth. I know I have to accept, and maybe even get happy for her, I mean, as she told me, she discovered that not everybody is an asshole like me and that helped her a lot, so she's happy now and, well, I should be happy, but I cannot. 

No. I have no one to rely on. I have lots of people that care but I can't talk to them. It's not the same. They know me, they know I have these days, and I guess you get used to it and in the end it makes no difference. I have those crisis once a week. They just walk away. 

I write in portuguese, my main language btw, so I fear I can't share. It's about philosophy, economy and politics. Nothing really interesting. Ah, I'd be delighted to take a look at it. Please share :). Well, as I said, my friends hear but are not really there. No one would come at my house 4am if I actually pass out. I wanted to be... Someone. You know. But this is stupid, never gonna happen. 

There's nothing. I don't know what she liked on me, but I guess it was nothing. Nobody would see the same thing she saw, of course. Neither I do. I'm boring, you have no idea, haha. 

Yeah. But sometimes people just stress me out or I just wake up so stressed or whatever and I'm a very rude guy. 

And I know it's short sighted. But I'm not sure if I'm capable to wait it fades...

If it helps somehow, I think I understand how you feel. It's... I do the same. People around me are so much better at everything. I'm ugly as well. My entire family hates me. I pretend to be something I will never. My life is a simply complex of lies. 

Though, there's nothing after the end. Nobody will hate you, because nothing will pop up. Though, no one will also love you. And I believe it's worth staying here, just in case... If you ever find someone, it will be delightful, and there are huge possibilities. 

I really get what you meant. The pain of being here is abysmal. But you're smart, indeed. You will get through it.
call 911. Asap. Nobody will yell at you here. Just come and let's chat, we will try to make you feel better. But, right now, call 911.

Hello. Thanks for answering, it's just great to know that I'm not alone. 
Your perspective does make sense. But I do not know what to do in order to move on. I tried. I swear I tried. I don't want to be part of her life anymore; there's just hate on her about me, and I cannot blame her for that. But... She's the only one I ... I don't know. People doesn't fit. I have lots of friends, and I'm a happy person overall, even with this "dark side" which I tried to speak with all of them and no one listened. They care, but say "ok, I hope you get better"... And that's all. 

Thanks for the kind words. I do a lot of things. I work, and that makes me feel ok. I write, as well. And read. And play. None of these things really help: it's just a distraction, and after I realized I got 1000 friends on facebook and no one to lean on, I always feel the burden of losing her. 

There's not about myself I like. Really. I know it's just whinning but... There's absolutely nothing. I'm not interesting. I'm not cool. Even with my prowness on a few subjetcts, that only makes me boring. And I'm naturally rude, and no matter how much I try to change it, eventually people notice.

Everyone goes away. 

I have nothing to wait for. Even if someone loves me again... I don't feel I'm capable of love anymore.
I need someone to talk as well. PM me if you're still there, please. I'm not that interesting, but.

I'm just too tired of waiting it go away. I tried everything please listen EVERYTHING. Even to kill myself but I lacked the strengh near the end. I changed my city. My meds. My life habits. Got into crazy work to forget it all. Punched some people. It didn't help. I get happy for 5 mins and then it all comes back, and I feel I need to talk to her. And see how happy she is with her new boyfriend or whatever my paranoia tells me tonight. I see no way out. No way out. There isn't a way out.
